thread:
marta: Pushing a tiny mock — trying a 'slim-left' pattern where groups collapse to icons and breadcrumbs take on more of the navigation context. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/nav-slim.png

kevin: Nice. First q: when a group is collapsed, do deep links keep the group id in the URL? e.g. /org/rdw/ws/123/model/abc vs /model/abc ?

samira: We should preserve a canonical URL shape for analytics and sharing. I'd prefer the long form (/ws/123/...) even if the UI shows only the icon. Keeps permalinks stable.

marta: Agreed. UX idea: collapsed icon still highlights as active and breadcrumb shows full path. So the visible UI is compact, but URL + breadcrumb preserve hierarchy.

lucas: Implementation note — that means router has to accept both /model/:id and /ws/:wsId/model/:id and map to same view. We should ensure older short links still work (redirect or rewrite).

kevin: Suggestion: router rule order: exact long form first, then short. Pseudocode:
```
// in router
if (match('/ws/:wsId/model/:id')) renderModel();
else if (match('/model/:id')) { // legacy
  const inferredWs = lookupWorkspaceForModel(id);
  replaceState(`/ws/${inferredWs}/model/${id}`, {preserveScroll: true});
}
```
This keeps canonical URL while not breaking shared short links.

samira: Important accessibility nit: when the left rail collapses to icons, keyboard users must have an accessible name (aria-label) and clear focus styling. We also need skiplinks to primary sections.

marta: Yup. Also thinking about back button behaviour: if user comes via a short link that rewrites to long form with history.replaceState (so no extra entry), hitting back should go to previous app page, not the short link intermediate. That matches expectations.

lucas: Tests: add e2e cases for deep links (short + long), and unit test for the lookup fallback. Also add a migration map for workspace ids so we can resolve older model links if an object moved.

kevin: UI affordance question: should collapsed icons show a hover tooltip only or a temporary popover with label+keyboard shortcut? I worry pure tooltip is too subtle for discoverability.

marta: Maybe both: tooltip on hover, and pressing ? or using a small expand chevron exposes labels. Also show breadcrumb affordance: if user tabs into breadcrumb, focus should land on the last actionable crumb and open the group if needed.

samira: Copy tweak: breadcrumbs should read 'Workspace: Payments > Model: pricing-v2' rather than just slugs. Use humanized labels. That improves clarity in shared screenshots.

nav-bot: reminder: design-bench tests scheduled Thu 10am. Please upload Figma variant (collapsed / expanded) to the 'nav-ia' board before EOD Wed. :calendar:

marta: Will do — I'll upload two variants and add a short notes layer describing router contract and a11y checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
